messages:
deploy-bot: Change window open for service-embed-v2 rollout. Rollout r-2026-05-25-embedv2. Traffic shift plan: 10% -> 50% over 15m. Run /release-check for smokechecks.

jules: kicking off preflight snapshot and warmup. grabbing SLO baseline (p95, error-rate, tail latency).

cheng: noted - starting traffic ramp. I'll watch p95 and 5xx.

maria: heads up — prod-eu has slightly older routing rules, may see skew in first 5m.

jules: /release-check output:
```
SLO snapshot: p50=30ms p95=120ms p99=320ms
5xx rate=0.18%
KV cache hit=88%
All subsystems OK -> proceeding to shift 10%
```

oncall-bot: :warning: alert: slo.p95(route=/embed) breached threshold (baseline 150ms) -> current 260ms at 10% traffic in eu-west. Alert ID A-6712.

cheng: I see the spike in eu-west. 5xx from embed-worker-3 at 10:12:23, stack traces show OOM during decoder batch flush.

dev-ops: tagging embed-worker-3 and cordoning it from the pool. Applying temporary routing rule to keep 10% on canary except eu-west.

maria: command I pushed to route rule service:
```json
{"route":"/embed","split":{"eu-west": "stable","global": "canary:10,stable:90"}}
```

jules: re-running /release-check after route split:
```
p95 eu-west=400ms (after cordon)
p95 global=140ms
5xx eu-west=1.6% -> trending down
Recommendation: pause rollout and investigate worker pool scaling/OOMs.
```

cheng: agree. Pause at 10% globally and pin rollout to previous version in eu-west only. I'll open a worker-scaling PR.

maria: creating a rollback pin for eu-west: `redwood roll pin --region eu-west --version embed-v1.9.3`

deploy-bot: Rollout paused (r-2026-05-25-embedv2) by dev-ops. Current traffic: canary 10% (global, excluding eu-west pinned to stable).

oncall-bot: :white_check_mark: action logged. Next check in 10m. Postmortem if >30min.

jules: adding brief notes to release notes: "Pause: observed region-specific p95/5xx spike in eu-west. Pinned region to stable, investigating worker memory profile."

cheng: I'll attach heap dumps and OOM logs to the incident thread.

dev-ops: reassigning oncall runbook step 2 -> performance team.

maria: thanks all — leaving a short checklist for resume: 1) confirm worker scaling fix merged and deployed 2) confirm p95 < 200ms across regions 3) ramp 10% -> 50% in 5m steps.

jules: noted. We'll reconvene after analysis.

maria: :thumbsup:
